integrity: The argument uses the exact characteristic polynomials and trace identity in Propositions 5.1 and 5.2 of arXiv:2610.01467v1, followed by explicit integer inequalities. The bundled computation is only a finite regression check; the all-integer conclusion is proved symbolically.
scientific_limitations: The source does not determine the geometric intersection parameter \(m\). The result classifies the homological spectra for every possible integral \(m\), but it does not determine the actual regime, the Jordan form at repeated roots, or the Nielsen–Thurston type of either mapping class.
title: A sharp two-orientation spectral trichotomy for the Cartwright–Steger nodal twists
